preconditions.description: The input string contains only '(' and ')' characters and its length does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The length of the longest substring that is a regular bracket sequence is a non-negative integer not exceeding the length of the input string.
The number of such substrings is a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^6.

invariants.expression: output_length == 0 and output_count == 1 implies there are no regular bracket sequences in the input string
invariants.description: If the longest substring is of length 0, then there is exactly one such substring, which is the empty string.
